description: This source file implements the MediaKeysIpc class and related functions for inter-process communication (IPC) in a media application. It handles creation, destruction, and management of media key sessions, as well as event handling for license requests, key status changes, and error reporting, using gRPC stubs and IPC channels.

classes.name: IMediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating MediaKeysIpc instances.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC communication for media key management, session handling, and event processing.

methods.description: Creates a factory for MediaKeysIpc instances.

methods.description: Destroys the media keys instance via IPC.
